name: review-flow
prompt: When reviewing code, report concrete defects with file and line references before any style nits.

commands.name: review
commands.prompt: Review the current git diff for correctness bugs, missing tests, and risky changes. Use the `reviewer` agent for the read-only pass. {$ARGS}

commands.name: ship
commands.description: Run the checks and summarize readiness
commands.prompt: Run the project's test and lint commands, then summarize whether the change is ready to merge.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Read-only code reviewer. Use it for a focused review pass over a diff or a set of files.
agents.system_prompt: You are a meticulous code reviewer. Read the code, trace the failure paths, and report concrete defects with file and line references. Do not modify files.
